requiredFindings.problem: S-OP-2 r6 item 3 requires the committed Markdown event reference and the same JSON to give every registered event its name, level, required identities, fields with kinds, classes and encoded bounds, sink projection, export candidacy and template, plus every code table with its provenance and every retired descriptor, and requires a drift test to check that rendering. O1-b registers host.phase.started, host.phase.completed, and the PhaseOutcome code table (completed, failed, cancelled, not-applicable). Both committed artifacts still list only log.stream.opened, log.loss.counted, host.repair.completed, storage.commit.published, and storage.commit.not_published, and their code tables omit PhaseOutcome. The drift renderer emits that same five-event list and the same tables() list, so the_committed_registry_reference_matches_the_registry passes in the final harness library run while the artifacts stay incomplete. The Rust Event implementations and the read-back descriptors do contain the two phase events, and the Sink code table does contain the harness member. The same artifacts' sink list still copies the pre-S-OP-2b rows and omits the harness sink row, classes P0 and P1, that bound S-OP-2b rule 1 adds.
